'''Kavin bills''' were a form of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] used on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]], the Kavin bills were already considered rare and ancient, but were still in circulation. [[Gunaray Dod]], the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented Cato Neimoidia during the war, was known to use Kavin bills when making business with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=general|Follow the Money|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref>
